title: Dimension formula for finite type schemes
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, $X$ a scheme of finite type over $K$, and
$x\in X$. Then

$$
\kundim_xX=\kundim\mathcal O_{X,x}+\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(x).
$$

(*Source:* Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma 29.29.1,
[Tag `02FX`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02FX),
applied to $X\to\Spec(K)$.)

proof.text: Choose an affine open U containing x using exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset, put R = Γ(X,U), and equip R with the K-algebra structure φ = (f.appLE ⊤ U).hom composed with ΓSpecIso.inv. The affine-pairs criterion Scheme.Hom.finiteType_appLE and the surjectivity of ΓSpecIso.inv make this a finite type K-algebra. Let p = hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x,hx⟩; hU.isoSpec sends x to p. No reducedness or irreducibility hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 02FX, lemma-dimension-fibre-at-a-point, proof (lines 5389–5393), specialized to Spec K

proof.text: The affine homeomorphism hU.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph preserves local topological dimension: preimages of open neighbourhoods and their induced embeddings give one inequality between the defining infima; the inverse homeomorphism gives the reverse. IsOpen.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq identifies the dimension at ⟨x,hx⟩ in U with the dimension at x in X. Thus dim_p Spec R = dim_x X.

source.place: Tag 02FX, lemma-dimension-fibre-at-a-point, proof (lines 5389–5393), specialized to Spec K

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_ringKrullDim_add_trdeg to the finite type K-algebra R and the prime p.asIdeal. It supplies natural numbers d and r with dim(R_p)=d, trdeg_K κ(p)=r, and dim_p Spec R=d+r.

source.place: Tag 02FX, lemma-dimension-fibre-at-a-point, proof (lines 5389–5393), specialized to Spec K

proof.text: Use hU.isLocalization_stalk and IsLocalization.algEquiv to construct the R-algebra isomorphism e:R_p≃O_(X,x). IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv gives an isomorphism er:κ(p)≃κ(x). Naturality of residues, Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap, and germ_res identify the canonical map K→κ(x) with ΓSpecIso.inv followed by f.appLE ⊤ U, the germ, and the residue. Since e commutes with R, er therefore commutes with K; AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv makes this explicit. ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv and ek.trdeg_eq transport the two invariants. Cardinal.toENat converts the finite cardinal r to the natural r, and Nat.cast_add finishes the unchanged formula.

lean.statement: theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_stalk_dimension_add_residue_trdeg {K : Type u} [Field K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of K))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K))] (x : X) : topologicalKrullDimAt x = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) + (Cardinal.toENat (@Algebra.trdeg K (X.residueField x) _ _ ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).residueFieldAlgebraMap x).toAlgebra) : WithBot ℕ∞)
